/pages/5/title: Scope of services and project start
/pages/5/summary: Describe the goal, the starting situation, the required features and your existing systems. From this, a verifiable draft emerges with assumptions, limits and next steps; a binding commitment is given separately.
/pages/5/sections/0/heading: Scope of services and project start
/pages/5/sections/0/body: Describe the goal, the starting situation, the required features and your existing systems. From this, a verifiable draft emerges with assumptions, limits and next steps; a binding commitment is given separately.
/pages/5/sections/1/heading: What you bring to the clarification
/pages/5/sections/1/body: Describe a concrete process: who starts it, which details are available, what is done by hand today and which result is needed? Name your existing website, calendar, inbox or specialist software and a person responsible for decisions. Anonymized examples are enough to start; access credentials do not belong in the request.
/pages/5/sections/2/heading: The intake becomes a verifiable scope
/pages/5/sections/2/body: We record which features belong to the project, which systems are to be connected and which assumptions are still open. For the review, concrete results are named, for example a complete enquiry or an access-protected document. A quote describes scope and version; a chat draft does not replace a binding agreement.
/pages/5/sections/3/body: Before the start, the responsible person, the required content and access, and the intended review path are clarified. In the preview you can check results and name change requests. New requirements are recorded together with their impact on scope and effort. For acceptance, the agreed results and the handover are documented; support afterwards is agreed separately.

/pages/6/sections/1/heading: Commission a project or use a product
/pages/6/sections/1/body: For a website, a custom automation or a portal, the path begins with clarifying your project and a dedicated quote. For the planned suite usage, NeX2fly explains registration and trial phase. one and one+ describe different tasks of the business AI; the API explains connecting your own applications. These paths have different prerequisites and are not a single combined flat service.
/pages/6/sections/2/heading: TEILEKLAR and your own shop project
/pages/6/sections/2/body: TEILEKLAR is the dedicated commerce area with search, product information and separate workshop and partner paths. If, instead, you are looking for a shop for your business, a separate project with your brand, your assortment and your ordering process is described. A shown sample replaces neither a confirmed stock level nor a binding delivery or payment function.
/pages/6/sections/3/body: A website can hand enquiries to a governed process; a portal can show the resulting project status. Which systems and data areas are connected is agreed explicitly. A shared brand presence does not imply automatic access between products or tenants. Available functions and prepared views stay distinguishable.

/pages/7/summary: Build-up and ongoing operation are discussed separately. The scope is clarified before the quote; operation and maintenance are a separate step. Unclarified tariffs or legal conditions are not published as binding prices.
/pages/7/sections/0/body: Build-up and ongoing operation are discussed separately. The scope is clarified before the quote; operation and maintenance are a separate step. Unclarified tariffs or legal conditions are not published as binding prices.
/pages/7/sections/1/body: The build-up concerns the agreed development or setup. Afterwards, your team can operate the solution itself according to the agreed handover, or choose a dedicated support scope. Model usage and other provider costs are considered separately. A development day rate does not describe a daily fee for later operation; what is actually charged is stated in the approved quote.
/pages/7/sections/2/body: For an existing building block, brand, content, rules and the required connection matter most. For a custom solution, a new data model, dedicated interfaces and the interplay of systems are added. Missing content, unclear access rights or additional approval paths are named as dependencies before the quote. An example implies neither a fixed price nor a promised completion date.
/pages/7/sections/3/heading: What you can check before deciding
/pages/7/sections/3/body: Which results are included, which services are not? Who operates and maintains the solution after acceptance? Which usage rights are handed over, and which ongoing third-party costs arise? These points belong in the written clarification. The suite trial and the one-time paid trial credit are explained on the NeX2fly page; they are not a price for an agency project.
